initiatives.name: Harriet Hancock LGBT Center
initiatives.description: Volunteer-staffed LGBTQ+ center in Columbia, SC. Runs social and peer-support programs and events, publishes a resource guide of affirming providers, and does advocacy work.

initiatives.name: The Ladies Room SC
initiatives.description: Black-led, trans-led LGBTQ+ center in Greenville, SC serving Black and Brown trans and nonbinary people with care navigation, HRT and name change help, housing and food assistance, and a weekly group.

initiatives.name: Carolina Abortion Fund
initiatives.description: Nonprofit abortion fund with a toll-free helpline offering financial, practical, and emotional support to people seeking abortions in North and South Carolina.

initiatives.name: Cypress Fund
initiatives.description: Social justice fund for North and South Carolina that gives grants to grassroots, BIPOC-led organizing groups and organizes donors. Runs the Rooted & Rise and Interdependence & Solidarity funds.

initiatives.name: Palmetto State Abortion Fund
initiatives.description: All-volunteer abortion fund in South Carolina that pays clinics and covers travel, lodging, gas and food for people seeking abortions from SC, GA, AL and MS.

initiatives.name: Rainy Day Fund
initiatives.description: Columbia, SC nonprofit that pays court costs and fees and coordinates legal help for people in South Carolina and Virginia whose main barrier is money.

initiatives.name: SC Housing Justice Network
initiatives.description: Statewide coalition of working-class tenants in South Carolina organizing for affordable, safe housing. Has announced a rename to SC Tenant Union.

initiatives.name: South Carolinians for Alternatives to the Death Penalty (SCADP)
initiatives.description: Greenville-based group working to abolish the death penalty in South Carolina through pen-pal programs, education events, community partnerships, and legislative advocacy.

initiatives.name: Carolina Migrant Network
initiatives.description: CMN offers free represent for people in NC/SC detention and removal proceedings.
